episodes.title: THE FIRST GIANT RETREATED
episodes.subtitle: IT WAS RETREATING.

reel.caption:
The giant wasn't attacking Earth. It was trying to escape.

A colossal titan froze above our planet as stars began disappearing beyond a dark ring.

Then its massive hand pulled away.

For the first time, something larger than Earth was afraid.

Whatever it saw... we haven't seen it yet.

Follow Colossus Signal. The next transmission gets darker.

#ColossusSignal #CosmicHorror #GiantAlien

Something out there terrified a creature bigger than our world.

What could make something that enormous retreat?

still.caption:
Three giants formed the last shield.

But in the final transmission, only two guardians remained visible.

Behind them, the darkness finally revealed a face—a living cosmic giant so immense that even the defenders looked small. Earth was beyond the frame. One guardian was missing.

Then the thing turned toward us.

IT FOUND US.

Where did the third guardian go?

#ColossusSignal #CosmicHorror #HalloweenHorror
